Author: dajoey
Name: Lazy FATE Automator
Description: Grinds open-world FATEs by prioritizing Twist of Fate experience bonuses, active progress, and proximity. Integrates with vnavmesh for flight/navigation, lifestream for zone teleports, and Gluttony Combo IPC to automatically lock optimal rotation settings. Use /lazyfate to open.
Punchline: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
